firstScreen.subtitle: Solutions from the Barkat-Stein portfolio are installed and implemented in a number of companies and facilities that are 'well-known' in various industries: from ventilated facades and engineering equipment on landmark civil and commercial construction sites to software solutions such as: - 'Digital Rock / Unified Reservoir' (in the oil and gas industry), - 'BIM Level 3' (in construction), - 'Virtual Factory' (in manufacturing industries), - '3D Printing' (in digital additive manufacturing), 'GEOMEDIA' (agricultural monitoring systems)

companyInfo.intro: BARKAT Group of Companies - Value Increasing Partner in the field of facade and engineering materials supply in the civil and commercial construction market, as well as IT solutions in such areas as: agriculture, aviation, metallurgy, oil and gas, mining, mechanical engineering and many others. The company is divided into several main divisions:
companyInfo.barkatStein: Barkat-Stein – expert in the world of facing materials made of marble, dolomite, clinker, terracotta panels and porcelain tiles for ventilated facades and interior design. Barkat-Stein architectural solutions will increase the investment attractiveness of any construction project.
companyInfo.barkat3DVille: Barkat-3D-Ville – reliable partner for supply and implementation of software for geodata management (GIS), 3D design (CAD) and product lifecycle management (PLM), as well as BIM technology tools.
companyInfo.barkatEngineering: Barkat-Engineering – expert in automation of internal engineering networks of buildings and structures.
companyInfo.barkatAgrospatial: Barkat-Agrospatial – following the principle 'MAKING FARMERS DIGITAL' our experts implement digital IT solutions in the agricultural sector, such as advanced agricultural monitoring systems.
